en.name: SWAYAM (Free Online Courses)
en.description: National MOOC platform offering free online courses from school to postgraduate level with certificates.
en.eligibility: Open to all learners; some courses have eligibility for credit/ exam.
en.benefits: Free quality courses, certificates (with exam fee), academic credit transfer where recognised.
application_steps: Take proctored exam (optional, paid) for certificate.
faqs: How do I get a SWAYAM certificate?
